description: Royal and destructive degrees as commonly listed in Russian-language astrology. Degree numbers are 1-based within each sign. Signs without an entry have no listed degree.
sources_note: Both sources give identical numbers; neither names an original author. Attribution to a specific school is not confirmed.
convention_note: The table lists a 30th degree (Aquarius 30). A 30th degree exists only in ordinal counting (29°00'–29°59'), so the table is ordinal: 'the 13th degree' = 12°00'–12°59'. This is the default. --degree-convention exact is kept only for comparison.
checked_points: Planets, North Node, ASC, MC and house cusps 2–12 of the natal and the solar-return chart.
